e33chat.screen.title: Chat
e33chat.description: Rebuilds the vanilla chat HUD in chat-app style
e33chat.config.title: E33Chat Settings
e33chat.config.theme.desc: Chat panel color theme: Dark or Light
e33chat.config.enabled.desc: Master switch for the E33Chat overlay
e33chat.config.red_dot.desc: Show a red dot on the chat icon when there are unread messages
e33chat.config.hide_chat_icon.desc: Hide the HUD chat icon completely
e33chat.config.animation.desc: Smooth open/close animation for the chat screen
e33chat.config.blur_enabled.desc: Apply a blur effect behind the chat panel background
e33chat.config.panel_opacity.desc: Chat panel background opacity percentage (0 = fully transparent, 100 = fully opaque)
e33chat.config.debug_log.desc: Verbose pipeline logging to latest.log for troubleshooting
e33chat.config.own_bubble_color.desc: Background color of your own chat bubbles
e33chat.config.other_bubble_color.desc: Background color of other players bubbles
e33chat.config.own_text_color.desc: Text color in your own bubbles
e33chat.config.other_text_color.desc: Text color in other players bubbles
e33chat.config.bubble_corner_radius.desc: Rounded corner radius for chat bubbles (0=square)
e33chat.config.strong_hint.desc: Show system messages as a popup above the hotbar
e33chat.config.mention_strong_hint.desc: Pop a hint above the hotbar when you are @mentioned or quoted
e33chat.config.system_chat_as_bubble.des: Render system messages as chat bubbles instead of gray text
e33chat.config.anti_spam.desc: Collapse repeated identical messages with a counter
e33chat.config.chat_history.desc: Save and restore chat history per world
e33chat.config.preserve_input.desc: Keep typed text when closing chat
e33chat.config.color_codes.desc: Interpret & codes as color in your own bubbles (safe, never kicks)
e33chat.config.preview_enabled.desc: Show recent message preview above the chat icon
e33chat.config.preview_lines.desc: Number of preview lines to show (3-10)
e33chat.config.sound_mention.desc: Play a notification sound when you are @mentioned or quoted
e33chat.config.sound_public.desc: Bell sound for public chat messages
e33chat.config.sidebar_hide_patterns.des: Hide player names matching these wildcards from whisper sidebar
e33chat.config.mention_banner_duration.d: How long the banner stays visible (2-10 seconds)
e33chat.config.mention_sound_enabled.des: Play a chime sound when @mentioned or whispered
e33chat.config.mention_whisper_banner.de: Also show banner for incoming private messages
e33chat.config.mention_require_at.desc: Only trigger when preceded by @ (otherwise bare name also works)
e33chat.config.banner_corner_radius.desc: Rounded corner radius for notification banners (0=square)
